public_rationale: In his own words, Zitron's test is whether the whole non-ChatGPT generative AI app market, outside China, in January 2025, was 'a little more than half' of 147 million monthly users, about 74 million. He counts assistants built into other apps, naming Amazon's Rufus as a missed 'app'. On that scope, Meta's own January 2025 earnings call reported more than 700 million monthly actives for Meta AI alone, about ten times his threshold. Google's court data put Gemini at 350 million monthly users by March 2025. The Pokémon Go comparison is also shaky: 147 million was a May 2018 figure described as the highest since the 2016 launch, not the all-time peak. If the claim is limited to standalone chatbot apps measured by Sensor Tower, it could not be checked independently. Under his stated scope, it does not hold.
limitations: The result turns on counting built-in assistants such as Meta AI. His mention of Rufus supports this, but he may have meant standalone apps only.
Meta's 'monthly actives' is a company-defined measure, not comparable to Sensor Tower's app counts, and it is global.
His 'it appears' marks the comparison as an estimate from the data he had.

our_interpretation: The criteria use only his words. His threshold is 'a little more than half' of 147 million, which is about 74 million monthly active users. His scope is 'the entire generative AI app market' excluding ChatGPT, in January 2025, outside China.
He counts Amazon's Rufus, an assistant built into the Amazon shopping app, as part of this market. So, by his own scope, AI assistants built into larger apps count.
'It appears' marks this as an estimate from the data he had. It is tested as a statement about the market's size, not as a claim about what his data showed.
The Pokémon Go figure is a second, factual element ('at its peak, when it had 147 million'). It is checked as context because it describes 2016 to 2018, not January 2025.
criteria.support_condition: Measures of January 2025 show the non-ChatGPT generative AI app market outside China at roughly 74 to 90 million monthly active users, and Pokémon Go's peak was 147 million monthly active users.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A credible January 2025 figure shows non-ChatGPT generative AI assistant users far above about 74 million monthly actives within his stated scope. Or Pokémon Go's peak was not 147 million.
